title: LedgerTrack legacy import: products.jsonl line (legacy currency)

source_id.description: Stable identifier of the currency in the legacy system.

code.description: LedgerTrack product code. Becomes part of the wallet id and of ledger addresses, so only letters, digits, '-' and '_' are allowed.

currency.description: Currency code. Must be enabled in GET /v2/ledgertrack/currencies.

precision.description: Optional. Fractional digits of the legacy currency. Used for offline validation; plan/apply/verify use the server value and fail on mismatch.

status.description: Target status. Default active. 'retired' products are activated for the import and retired at the end.

rules.description: Passed through to the product rules. rules.min_opening_balance must be '0' or absent because accounts are opened without a deposit.
